text:
miles Hey team — quick midday check: vendor X just messaged that there are 4 H100 slots available in us-west2 for ~48h. Can we borrow 4 for a short canary sweep? Need quick billing + infra signoff. @sarah any objections? :eyes:
sarah Which pool exactly? and do we need persistent mounts?
miles dev-inference-canary pool, ephemeral runs only (smoke + model-sweep, low QPS). No persistent mounts, just docker images and S3.
devops-bot quick heads-up: cross-cloud borrow requires an infra PR + allocation ticket. Please include pool tag and requested time window. See: https://internal.redwood/alloc-handbook :books:
liam I can open the infra PR. @procure-bot can you confirm vendor ETA and whether they need a PO uplift?
procure-bot Vendor X ETA: ~36h to provision racks in us-west2. They have 4 H100s reservable but require PO uplift > $2k. Quoted vendor ticket: #VX-4412.
anita Finance check: we can do a one-off PO uplift if cost center + approver provided. Need line item (hours x gpu) or a capped dollar amount.
miles Cost center: cc-789. Request cap: $2.5k for the run window (should be plenty). Approver: @tasha.
tasha Approved for canary budget up to $2.5k, conditional: runs must finish within 6h total and telemetry turned on. :white_check_mark:
liam Opening PR now — will include terraform snippet and canary window. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/2345 (wip). Snippet:```resource "redwood_alloc" "canary_h100_usw2" {  pool = "dev-inference-canary"  gpu = "h100"  count = 4  window = "2026-04-02T14:00Z/2026-04-02T20:00Z"  owner = "liam"}```
ops Quick note: route through us-west2-a only (we've seen cross-az perf variance). Add label `az=us-west2-a` in the PR. Also add a canary fallback to l40s if vendor fails.
miles Will add az label + fallback policy. If vendor slips, we fallback to local l40s pool (1-2 GPUs) and rerun reduced sweep.
liam PR #2345 opened, assigned to @sarah for infra review and @anita for billing sign-off. Will link vendor PO once procured.
procure-bot Vendor X needs PO uplift form filled: https://procure.redwood/forms/po-uplift?ticket=VX-4412 — tagging @anita to confirm.
anita I'll fill the form and issue PO once PR references cost center and cap. Expect PO within 12h.
sarah I'll do a quick infra review this afternoon. Can you add a short smoke test that fails fast if startup takes >7m?
miles Yep — will add smoke test and telemetry flags. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
ops leaving a reminder: post-run please drop a one-line note in #incidents if latency/regression observed so SRE can snapshot logs.
miles Will do. Closing loop once PR merged and PO is confirmed. Thanks! :pray:
